structure: Part 5 (Origin, arrival status and arrival details) read in full the three feature folders under src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features: origin/ (page.js, evaluation.js, controller.js 191 lines, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, origin.fit.spec.js 556 lines), arrival-status/ (page.js, evaluation.js, statuses.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy en/cy, arrival-status.fit.spec.js 415 lines) and arrival-details/ (page.js, evaluation.js, fields.js, arrival-bounds.js, controller.js 219 lines, template.njk, copy en/cy, arrival-details.fit.spec.js 586 lines), plus features/timing-windows.js and obligations/sections/origin.js and arrival.js. It covers three pages in the order origin -> arrival status (plants for planting and wood only) -> arrival details -> place of destination: the origin page (/notifications/{id}/origin, type-ahead country picker over the SPS origin list, narrowed per commodity category with inset guidance and narrowing errors), the arrival status page (/notifications/{id}/arrival-status, two radios with timing hints), and the arrival details page (/notifications/{id}/arrival-details, one MoJ date picker whose label and hint change in three states, plus a 24-hour time and a proposed place of landing for potatoes only). It claims the four obligations (countryOfOrigin, arrivalStatus, arrivalDate, arrivalTime, proposedPlaceOfLanding) with their gates, the two timing-window constants, the arrival-date upper bound for an already-arrived consignment, stale-answer handling, the provisional and machine-draft Welsh copy markers, and every test in the three fit specs. Unit tests (*.test.js) are out of scope. The origin-constraint definitions themselves live in the commodities service (another part); this part claims only what the origin page shows of them.

claims.statement: arrivalTime is mandatory only for potatoes (reason 'arrivalTime applies to notifications for potatoes') and is purged when the notification changes to another commodity type.
claims.quote: the time is a potato matter and the engine purges it when a notification changes to another commodity type.

claims.statement: proposedPlaceOfLanding is mandatory only for potatoes (reg 24A(2)(aa); reason 'proposedPlaceOfLanding applies to notifications for potatoes') and plants and wood are never asked.
claims.quote: Reg 24A(2)(aa) is the only landing element in the statute; reg 26(2) has none, so plants and wood are never asked.
